Become the king of the hunt.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Shotgun

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 2 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Shotgun Rechamber • Mods: None

Special Features: Despite being Iconic, this weapon can load Non-Basic Ammunition. Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Each of this weapon’s two barrels can load a different ammunition type (Can be Slug or Shell), with the user choosing which to use when firing this weapon. When firing this weapon, the user may instead choose to fire both barrels simultaneously (As long as both loaded rounds are a Slug or Shell), expending both loaded rounds and applying the effects of both loaded ammunition types simultaneously onto any hit targets. When attacking a target within 6m/yds with this weapon and rolling for damage, any damage die that land on a 1 are re-rolled until they result in a higher value.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Shotgun
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Shotgun Rechamber (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
